==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
There is a corridor with a tiled floor that I like to pace in. I am asked to explain the purpose of the corridor, as people question how I could live in a big empty room. I don't tell them that I am not human and that I don't require sleep.

I give a tour of the corridor and I am surprised to see a wall with a small square hole in the center. I approach the wall with suspicion. When I get close enough to the hole it sucks me in and I appear in a different room.

Inside this other room is a colorful bunk bed and gray carpet. On the carpet, I am shocked to see a small red spider robot. I am relieved as I believed my spider robot had been lost forever.

Twenty minutes later, after I wake up from the dream, my UFO detector goes off for the second time this week.
